text: 真的不惑之年 啥问题都明白了 也知道该怎么办了
en: In truth, at the age of no doubts, one understands every problem and knows what to do.

text: 不明白的可以问我
en: Those who do not understand may ask me.

text: 连天命也知道了
en: One even knows one's destiny.

text: 爱还是主题 更加坚定
en: Love remains the theme, all the more steadfast.

text: 办事宽容洒脱 与世界和解
en: Handle affairs with tolerance and ease, and make peace with the world.

text: 一个小兄弟..说认识了知心大姐姐.
en: A young brother.. said he had got to know an understanding elder sister.

text: 我说快离婚了.就差你个鲨雕去点火买单了
en: I said she is about to get divorced. The only thing missing is for you, you fool, to go and stir the fire and pick up the tab.

text: 中国的孩子们.千万要学好金融.学好金融..输不可怕..可怕的学玩空手套白狼.你觉得空手套白狼的.其实不是..
en: China's children. Do be sure to learn finance well. Learn finance well.. losing is not to be feared.. what is to be feared is learning to play at getting something for nothing. Those you think are getting something for nothing.. in fact are not..

text: 中年这个年纪，自己安排得当，就可以过成意气风发，收获丰盛的年纪。
en: The age of middle years, when one arranges things well, can become a time of vigour and abundant reward.

text: 因为中年这个年纪获得的财富健康学识等收获，是到任何时候都不会被抹去的坚实存在。
en: For the wealth, health, knowledge and other gains obtained at the age of middle years are solid existences that can never be erased at any time.

text: 但是中年这个年纪，也让很多人因为内在涵养的不足而失去之前努力得到的很多宝贵生活财富。
en: But the age of middle years also lets many people, through insufficient inner cultivation, lose much precious life wealth they had striven to obtain before.

text: 比如
en: For instance

text: 1.健康
en: 1. Health

text: 身体没有年轻那些日子轻快动力十足了，绝不是放弃中年人身体的借口。
en: That the body is not as light and energetic as in those younger days is absolutely no excuse to give up on the middle-aged body.

text: 如果把握了中年的健康，将获得一生健康的身体底子财富。
en: If one grasps middle-aged health, one will gain the foundational wealth of a healthy body for life.

text: （1）主动运动
en: (1) Active exercise

text: 中年人，力量较少，心力疲惫，骨骼中钙流失开始了，其实更加需要主动参与户外有氧运动。
en: Middle-aged people, with less strength, mental exhaustion, and the onset of calcium loss in the bones, in fact need all the more to take part actively in outdoor aerobic exercise.

text: 比如到公园里慢跑，无论习惯选择清晨或是傍晚，都是运动健身的绝佳选择。
en: For example, jogging in the park, whether one is used to choosing early morning or evening, is an excellent choice for exercise and fitness.

text: 运动可以缓解中年人工作和家庭生活的劳累感，减少比起年轻更容易囤积的小肚腩，有效的运动规律方法和自我保护，还可以让自己拥有腹肌，纤细的腰围，笔直的肩背线条，还有好的心情。
en: Exercise can ease the fatigue of middle-aged people's work and family life, reduce the little paunch that is more easily accumulated compared with youth, and effective, regular exercise methods and self-protection can also let one have abdominal muscles, a slender waistline, straight shoulder and back lines, and a good mood.

text: 拥有这些健康财富，运动，何乐而不为呢？
en: Possessing these healthy riches, why not take exercise?

text: 中年人可以培养和发现自己的一两个运动爱好，比如有的人喜欢篮球，有人喜欢跑步机，有人喜欢跳舞，有人喜欢椭圆机，有人喜欢户外跑步，等等。
en: Middle-aged people can cultivate and discover one or two sporting hobbies; for example, some like basketball, some like treadmills, some like dancing, some like ellipticals, some like outdoor running, and so on.

text: 以上都是很健康的生活运动方式。
en: All of the above are very healthy ways of living and exercising.

text: 坚持下来，其实是对健康的一个 存款，而这个健康储蓄与存款的效果，在人们度过了壮年的中年步入了老年，就可以逐渐看出来区别。
en: Keeping it up is in fact a deposit into health, and the effect of this health saving and deposit can gradually be seen to differ once people have passed the prime of middle age and entered old age.

text: 年老仍然有着健康财富，比起失去了健康的老年人的生活，会有质量得太多。
en: Remaining in old age with healthy wealth, compared with the life of elderly people who have lost their health, will be of far greater quality.

text: （2）睡眠储蓄
en: (2) Sleep savings

text: 如果把运动坚持当作年轻和中年对老年健康的一个重要储蓄，那么睡眠，也是一个健康得丰厚储蓄。
en: If persisting in exercise is regarded as an important saving for old-age health during youth and middle age, then sleep is also a rich saving of health.

text: 虽然工作劳累，也不要透支健康。
en: Though work is tiring, do not overdraw your health.

text: 因为人到了60岁就退休了，但是生活还要继续，健康也要继续。
en: For people retire at sixty, but life must go on, and so must health.

text: 我们要对自己终身得健康负责。
en: We must be responsible for our lifelong health.

text: 早睡，早起，至少要做到一样，养成好习惯。
en: Sleep early, rise early; at the very least achieve one of them, and form a good habit.

text: 因为早睡和早起是相互联系的。
en: For sleeping early and rising early are interconnected.

text: 很多人有这样的感受，晚上睡晚了，熬夜或是其他原因晚11点以后再睡觉，那么早起也几乎没了保证。
en: Many people have this feeling: if one sleeps late at night, stays up late or, for other reasons, goes to sleep after eleven at night, then rising early is almost no longer guaranteed.

text: 只有早睡，才能保证早起，形成生活习惯，受益多多。
en: Only by sleeping early can one guarantee rising early, form a living habit, and benefit greatly.

text: 有研究表明，大脑会对睡眠形成睡眠记忆，当睡眠长期不足，那么大脑会对睡眠进行 讨债。
en: Research shows that the brain forms a sleep memory of sleep; when sleep is long deficient, the brain will come to collect the debt from sleep.

text: 就会造成对身体的大大损耗。
en: This will cause great depletion to the body.

text: 昨天睡好了，第二天感觉高质量生活的长度都多一些。
en: If one slept well yesterday, the next day one feels there is a little more high-quality living to be had.

text: 睡少了，第二天就昏昏沉沉过去，工作生活的质量都很低。
en: Slept little, and the next day passes in a daze, with very low quality of work and life.

text: 良好的睡觉习惯是今天的自己对明天的自己负责。
en: A good sleeping habit is today's self being responsible for tomorrow's self.

text: (3)稳定的情绪状态。
en: (3) A stable emotional state.

text: 年轻人情绪不稳定，解释为年轻气盛，这是对于年轻人的宽容。
en: Young people's emotional instability is explained as youthful vigour, which is a tolerance shown towards the young.

text: 但是中年人以后情绪不稳定，就是对自己形象的损坏，被归结为个人内涵不高修养不够。
en: But emotional instability after one becomes middle-aged is damage to one's own image, attributed to low personal inner cultivation and insufficient refinement.

text: 所以能用稳定的情绪，平静冷静的心态面对一些问题，是中年人心智成熟的必经阶段。
en: Therefore being able to face some problems with stable emotions and a calm, cool mindset is a necessary stage of the middle-aged person's mental maturity.

text: 特别说说女性 中年人，女性到了中年，内心会经历一个很强烈的适应期。
en: Let us speak specifically about female middle-aged people: when women reach middle age, their hearts undergo a very intense period of adaptation.

text: 在这个适应期的开始，就是女性刚到中年的不适应。
en: At the beginning of this period of adaptation is the woman's discomfort upon just reaching middle age.

text: 年纪到了30几岁了，觉得自己跟20多岁区别不大，但是照照镜子，自己确实跟大街上看到的中年人的样子没什么不同。
en: Having reached one's thirties, one feels not much different from one's twenties, but looking in the mirror, one truly looks no different from the middle-aged people seen on the street.

text: 不得不承认，青春已去。
en: One has to admit that youth has gone.

text: 青春自然是美好的，但是中年的女性同样可以焕发优秀的魅力，这种魅力不止于形象气质装容打扮，更在于气质阳光温和宽容，谈吐自然，这些内在涵养无形透露出来的个人形象，可以让中年女性社会形象大大加分。
en: Youth is naturally wonderful, but middle-aged women can likewise radiate excellent charm; this charm lies not only in image, temperament, make-up and dress, but more in a sunny, gentle and tolerant temperament and natural speech — these inner cultivations, invisibly revealed in one's personal image, can greatly add to a middle-aged woman's social image.

text: 所以，健康这里，有着运动，睡眠，以及心态三样法宝，可以让中年生活更踏实美好。
en: Therefore, in matters of health, there are three magic tools — exercise, sleep, and mindset — that can make middle-aged life steadier and more beautiful.

text: 2.社会适应能力
en: 2. Social adaptability

text: 社会力是个综合概念，我们看看人到30多岁的中年，需要的重要社会力。
en: Social capacity is a comprehensive concept; let us look at the important social capacity needed by people in their thirties, at the stage of middle age.

text: （1）核心竞争力
en: (1) Core competitiveness

text: 这是自古至今人们得以存在的根本能力。
en: This is the fundamental ability by which people have been able to exist from ancient times to the present.

text: 自然是有着一些对社会有用的特长技能的人们，称之为个人核心竞争力，是任何人拿不走，保证人们顺利生存在社会上的重要保证。
en: Naturally there are people with some special skills useful to society; these are called one's personal core competitiveness, an important guarantee that no one can take away and that ensures people survive smoothly in society.

text: 也就是365行，行行出状元。
en: That is to say, of the three hundred and sixty-five trades, every trade produces its champion.

text: 在任何一个行业，本行业的专业工作技能必不可少。
en: In any trade, the professional working skills of that trade are indispensable.

text: （2）识人辨认
en: (2) Reading and discerning people

text: 人们存在着，总要跟其他人交往沟通。
en: As people exist, they must always interact and communicate with others.

text: 处于必要还是无奈，并不是重点，重点是我们一同生存在一个社会中，互相的联系是肯定的，就算是逃避社交的人们，也必须有一些交往生活。
en: Whether out of necessity or helplessness is not the point; the point is that we live together in a society, and mutual connection is certain — even those who avoid socialising must have some social life.

text: 哪怕是去超市买个东西，到公交车打个车，买个菜，哪里有不跟任何人交往的人存在呢？
en: Even going to the supermarket to buy something, getting on a bus, or buying vegetables — where is there a person who does not interact with anyone?

text: 所以很多典籍里，都把人际关系当作一个很大的学问，因为这是人人都逃不了的一个课程，人人必学，人人必用。
en: Therefore many classics treat interpersonal relations as a great learning, because this is a course no one can escape, that everyone must study and everyone must use.

text: （3）辨事处事
en: (3) Discerning and handling affairs

text: 识人以后辨人知人，同样的，知事以后辨事处事。
en: After recognising people, one discerns and knows them; likewise, after knowing affairs, one discerns and handles them.

text: 这些人与事的掌控能力表现在人们社会生活工作每个小事大事上，大多数人到了中年，也就慢慢形成了自己的一个 行为处事模式，也就是常常说的性格，个性，特征等等，这些特点，随着越来越多地重复，也许到了一个人老年，就成了一些根深蒂固的个人特点了，比如很多人说，老顽固老顽固，就含这个意思。
en: This ability to control people and affairs manifests in every small and great matter of people's social, living and working life. Most people, by middle age, slowly form their own pattern of conduct and handling affairs — that is, what is often called character, personality, traits, and so on. As these features are repeated more and more, by the time one reaches old age they may become deeply rooted personal traits; for example, many speak of 'old stubborn, old stubborn,' which carries this meaning.

text: 有个流行词叫做复盘，建议现在拼命快速适应社会飞速发展的人们，中年人们，学一学复盘，一天闭上眼睛5分钟，安静下来，想想今天过去的这一天，有哪些漏洞，自己的行为也好，工作内容也好，还有哪些没有做好的，有哪些是做到好的。
en: There is a popular term called 'retrospective'; I suggest that people who are now striving to adapt quickly to society's rapid development — middle-aged people — learn this retrospective: close your eyes for five minutes a day, quiet down, and think about the day that has passed — what loopholes there were, whether in your own conduct or in your work, what was not done well, and what was done well.

text: 强化自己的优点和弱点记忆，对未来提高效率帮助很大。
en: Strengthening the memory of one's strengths and weaknesses helps greatly to raise efficiency in the future.

text: 这个方法很适合生活工作压力大，逐渐感觉疲惫力不从心的中年人群。
en: This method suits very well middle-aged people under great pressure from life and work, who gradually feel tired and unable to cope.

text: 3.生活适应力
en: 3. Life adaptability

text: （1）情感维系与感知
en: (1) Emotional maintenance and perception

text: 亲情，友情都在每个人的中年陆续上演了，也有一些中年人在等待着美好的爱情。
en: Kinship and friendship both unfold in everyone's middle age in turn, and some middle-aged people are also waiting for beautiful romantic love.

text: 感情，是人生中的必经经历，要知道，稳固性，亲情大于友情。
en: Emotion is a necessary experience in life; one must know that, in terms of stability, kinship surpasses friendship.

text: 同样的，友情在时间洗刷下，有的能沉淀下来成为了友谊的美酒，人生的财富。
en: Likewise, under the washing of time, some friendships settle down and become the fine wine of friendship, a wealth of life.

text: 就是因为亲情的无私，就像人们呼吸的空气喝的水一样无形自然存在，所以往往被我们忽略了。
en: Precisely because kinship is selfless, existing invisibly and naturally like the air we breathe and the water we drink, it is often overlooked by us.

text: 但是亲情是重要的感情存在，就像空气水一样是人生不可或缺的感情，拥有着亲情的人们一定要珍惜。
en: But kinship is an important emotional existence, like air and water, an indispensable feeling in life; those who possess kinship must treasure it.

text: 爱情到了婚姻，也有一部分转化为了亲情，所以，亲情的含义也非常深厚，我们要好好保护这些珍贵的来之不易的珍贵真挚感情。
en: Romantic love, upon reaching marriage, also partly transforms into kinship; therefore the meaning of kinship is also very profound, and we must properly protect these precious, hard-won and sincere feelings.

text: 到了中年，更要分辨不必要的感情羁绊，把自己有限的精力用在更加重要的真诚的生活和感情中。
en: Upon reaching middle age, one must all the more distinguish unnecessary emotional entanglements, and use one's limited energy on more important, sincere living and feeling.

text: 如果青春就是容许犯一些不痛不痒的小错的，那么中年，就经不起人们再犯错了。
en: If youth is about permitting some painless, insignificant little mistakes, then middle age cannot bear people to make mistakes again.

text: 因为中年犯错的代价往往大到自己承受不起。
en: For the cost of a mistake in middle age is often so great that one cannot bear it oneself.

text: 就像一个人只有10块钱，弄丢了10块钱，顶多也就是从0开始赚10块钱，不难。
en: It is like a person with only ten yuan, who loses ten yuan — at most one starts from zero to earn ten yuan again; not difficult.

text: 但是中年是厚积薄发的人生阶段，好比一个人已经通过少年青年的努力，辛辛苦苦得到了10万，这时候如果损失了10万块，从0开始，谈何容易。
en: But middle age is a stage of life in which deep accumulation is released; it is like a person who, through the efforts of youth, has laboriously gained one hundred thousand yuan — if at this point one loses that hundred thousand, starting from zero is easier said than done.

text: 10块和10万块仅仅只是一个比方，在人们生活中，代表的不仅是财富，还有名誉，地位，前途，健康，家庭，等等重要生命组成。
en: Ten yuan and one hundred thousand yuan are merely a metaphor; in people's lives they represent not only wealth, but also reputation, status, prospects, health, family, and other important components of life.

text: 所以，中年人不要犯感情错误，对自己的家庭，亲情，前途，都会有太大影响，往往会让自己处于人生被动之中。
en: Therefore middle-aged people must not make emotional mistakes, for these greatly affect one's family, kinship and prospects, and often leave oneself in a passive position in life.

text: （2）家庭与个人生活平衡
en: (2) Balance between family and personal life

text: 中年人生活变得比较规律，待在家里的时间都基本固定，如何用好这在家里的不多的时间，就是一门中年人都要考虑的大学问了。
en: The lives of middle-aged people become fairly regular, and the time spent at home is basically fixed; how to make good use of this limited time at home is a great learning that all middle-aged people must consider.

text: 周末用一天整理清理房间和家庭卫生，用另一天陪伴家人果果亲子生活，就是再理想不过的生活了。
en: Using one day at the weekend to tidy and clean the room and the home, and the other day to accompany family and enjoy parent-child life with Guoguo, is the most ideal life imaginable.

text: 先玩要留出一星期至少一天的时间休息陪伴家人朋友，不要被工作奴役，这些放松的快乐回忆让自己觉得生命更加有意思，也更能抵挡对于持续工作的厌倦心里不足。
en: First, one must set aside at least one day a week to rest and accompany family and friends; do not be enslaved by work. These relaxed, happy memories make one feel life is more meaningful, and better resist the weariness of continual work.

text: 就好比弹簧，被工作拉得太紧了， 需要松一松，让弹簧释放一下压力，才能保障弹簧保持持久如初的弹力。
en: It is like a spring, pulled too tight by work; it needs to loosen, to let the spring release its pressure, so as to ensure the spring keeps its original, lasting elasticity.

text: （3）持续输入
en: (3) Continuous input

text: 很多人建议多阅读，这是很好的建议。
en: Many suggest reading more; this is a very good suggestion.

text: 其实不仅仅是书籍，还有生活工作，我们都可以接收很多新的知识，新的概念，感受清新的心情。
en: In truth it is not only books, but also life and work, from which we can receive much new knowledge, new concepts, and feel a fresh mood.

text: 出去旅游与读书有着相同的扩大见闻的效果。
en: Going travelling has the same effect as reading in broadening one's horizons.

text: 祝大家度过一个健康，快乐，美好的中年生活，丰富人生，为可贵的生命打上厚实的底色！
en: I wish everyone a healthy, happy and wonderful middle-aged life, enriching life and laying a solid foundation for one's precious existence!

text: 作者：穌 燚。
en: Author: Yi Su.
